answer_1.quote: We evaluate our re-aligned captions across captioning, generative and discriminative tasks. ... Our Altogether captioner improves over alt-texts by 4% on CLIP score and significantly outperforms off-the-shelf captioners such as GiT, BLIP2 and LLaVA.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU/METEOR/ROUGE/CIDEr metrics and noun phrase (NP) precision, recall and F1 score. ... We first evaluate the alignment between the images and captions via CLIP score.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct human evaluation by presenting the images, alt-texts and the captions produced by various models, and asking evaluators about three criteria: Whether the caption (i) is aligned with the image & has fewer hallucinations; (ii) is specific (named entities, detailed description); (iii) carries useful information from the alt-text.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to rate the captions on three criteria: alignment & hallucination reduction, specificity, and usefulness of alt-text information.
